title: Microsoft Purview DLP: browse and buy partner integrations through the embedded Security Store
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says Marketplace purchase controls are unconfirmed for Security Store purchases. Microsoft's Security Store private-offer instructions explicitly require Marketplace purchase eligibility and approval checks; the briefing also overstates purchase as a prerequisite for every integration.

claims.claim: Security Store is now integrated into the Microsoft Purview DLP experience.
claims.quote: Microsoft Security Store is now integrated into the Microsoft Purview DLP experience

claims.claim: The embedded store lets administrators discover a curated set of integrations extending Purview, including network data security.
claims.quote: giving admins an in-product way to discover a curated set of integrations that extend Purview capabilities, including data security capabilities for the network.

claims.claim: Purchasing and management are completed through Security Store.
claims.quote: Purchasing and management are completed through Security Store, simplifying how organizations procure partner integrations.

claims.quote: Check the order details. Read the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Select Place Order to finish.

claims.claim: Network discovery or protection requires a configured integration and collection or DLP policy.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationales: risk and impact
claims.claim: Nothing can be connected, inspect traffic or affect users and data until someone buys a solution through the store; buying is the data-exposure control.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Security Store Purview DLP no traffic inspected until purchase integration existing subscription trial. Opened Security Store overview, SaaS purchase instructions, network-data-security-learn and dlp-create-policy-ai-network-data-security; none states a universal purchase gate.
claims.fix: Replace the summary's second sentence with 'Purchasing requires a deliberate checkout; decide who may buy and on which Azure subscription.' Replace the no-traffic-until-purchase assertion and the rationales' purchase prerequisite with 'Network discovery and protection require a configured integration and collection or DLP policy.' Replace 'The decision to buy is the control' with 'Review the integration and policy configuration before sharing data.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-network-data-security-learn.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Non-Microsoft partners can access and possibly store policy configuration, including user identifiers, under their own terms and privacy policy.
claims.quote: If you choose to integrate with non-Microsoft partners, they will be able to access and possibly store some policy configuration, including user identifiers. Their terms, conditions, and privacy policy will govern the usage and storage of this data.

claims.quote: the solution sends any matching network data to Microsoft Purview for classification and policy evaluation.

claims.claim: Content capture configured in a collection policy sends the full user-AI conversation to Purview.
claims.quote: If you configure content capture in the collection policy, the full conversation that happens between the user and the AI app is captured and sent to Microsoft Purview as well.

claims.quote: Complete setup and give consent for Microsoft Entra apps.

claims.quote: Purview network data security policies don't apply to B2B guest users.
